privacy.audioLocal: What you play stays on your device. We never send or store audio.

welcome.title: Welcome to {{appName}}!
welcome.subtitle: Learn to play the piano – on your real piano. I'll listen and help you along.
welcome.passkeyHint: With fingerprint, face or device PIN – no password needed.
welcome.registrationClosed: New accounts cannot be created at the moment.

email.title: Sign in with e-mail
email.codeSent: If the address is valid, we've sent you a 6-digit code.
email.needsName: There is no account for this address yet. What is your name?
email.registerIntro: Enter your e-mail address. We will send you a code to confirm your account. You can set up a passkey afterwards under “Account”.
email.loginIntro: We will send a 6-digit code to your e-mail address.
email.nameHint: Your name is only shown in the app. For a family account, e.g. “The Smiths”.
email.registrationClosed: New accounts cannot be created at the moment. Existing accounts can still sign in.

profiles.title: Who's playing today?
profiles.name: Name
profiles.modeHint: Lessons are the same in both styles.
profiles.empty: Create a profile for everyone who learns – for example you and your kids.
profiles.deleteConfirm: Delete profile “{{name}}” and all its progress?
profiles.passkeyNudge: Tip: set up a passkey and next time you sign in with your fingerprint or face – no e-mail code needed.

dashboard.mascotKids: Great to see you! Your first lesson is coming soon.

account.title: Account
account.passkeysHint: With a passkey you sign in using your fingerprint, face or device PIN – faster than an e-mail code. Set one up on every device you practise with.
account.emailHint: Used to sign in with a code when no passkey is at hand.
account.dangerHint: Deletes your account with all profiles and progress. This cannot be undone.
account.noPasskeys: No passkey set up yet. Until then you sign in with an e-mail code.

admin.title: Administration
admin.registrationOpenHint: When switched off, no new accounts can be created. Existing accounts can still sign in with a passkey or e-mail code.

errors.EMAIL_CODE_INVALID: The code is wrong or has expired.
errors.EMAIL_IN_USE: This e-mail address is already in use.
errors.TOO_MANY_CODES: Too many codes requested. Please wait a few minutes.
errors.PASSKEY_UNKNOWN: We don't know this passkey. Maybe it was deleted?
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment.
errors.REGISTRATION_CLOSED: New accounts cannot be created at the moment.
